title: Raphon Tuhan Jesus I
chord: Ab · G · Am · F · C · G · F · Ab
lyrics:
O Tuhan Jesus Ho Rajangku
Tangihon au naposoM on
Naeng topotanku do dosangku
Tu Ho Sigomgom tano on
Ai naeng mangolu tondingki
Marhitehite mudarMi

Godang do dosa ni tanganku
Rohangku pe gok dosa do
Nang mate pe nang pamatanghu
Luhutna i gok dosa do
Sai sesa nasa dosangki
Marhitehite mudarMi

O Jesus na marasiroha
Di saluhut pardosa i
Ondihon hami ai naeng jora
Do hami mangulahon i
Sai sesa dosanami i
Marhitehite mudarMi

Sai lehon ma tu tondinami
TondiM na sun badia i
Ibana mangajari hami
Mangaradoti patikMi
Parbadiai ma hami be
Marhitehite mudarMi

Pasaor ma hami tu punguan
Ni angka na badia i
Na sonang di Banua ginjang
Mamujimuji goarMi
Pamasuk hami be tusi
Marhitehite mudarMi
